notes: Every rule is deterministic. No rule carries predictive status; all are 'unvalidated' until a separate research process says otherwise.

conventions.gematria: Letters only, case-insensitive. Ciphers: EO (a=1..z=26), FR (EO digit-reduced), RO (a=26..z=1), RR (RO digit-reduced), CH (Chaldean).
conventions.prime_index: 1-based: 2 is the 1st prime, 23 is the 9th prime.
conventions.DN2: month + day + each digit of the year (10+22+2+0+2+6 = 42)
conventions.DN3: every digit of month, day and year (1+0+2+2+2+0+2+6 = 15)
conventions.DN5: digits of month and day + two-digit year (1+0+2+2+26 = 31)
conventions.DAYS_LEFT: days remaining in the year after the event date
conventions.birthday: Exact spans from birth date to event date. Feb 29 birthdays are observed on Feb 28 in non-leap years. Spans are distinct anchors and never substituted for one another.
conventions.triple_prime_sync: At least 3 prime-related hits drawn from at least 3 distinct source families AND at least 3 distinct source numbers.

REVPRIME-M.name: Reverse prime milestone
REVPRIME-M.qualification: reverse(M) is prime and reverse(M) != M

PIGR-A.name: Prime milestone to gematria index
PIGR-A.qualification: M is prime and prime_index(M) == G

PIGR-B.name: Gematria prime to milestone index
PIGR-B.qualification: G is prime and prime_index(G) == M

SYM.name: Symbolic code
SYM.qualification: value is in a locked symbolic set
